Description: Baseline: float32 data; original separate-branch Keras ensemble
Vectorised ensemble in Keras: stack E inputs one batched matmul per layer split E outputs
Auto-tune steps_per_execution to full epoch: negligible speedup; RMSE/NLPD slightly worse
Pre-compile XLA in __init__ before Timer: moves 29s compile cost outside optimize()
Prefetch after batch: no improvement; in-memory data already fast
Vectorised bootstrap sampling: one batched tf.gather per tensor instead of E separate calls
Pre-batch dataset: reshape [N,D] to [n_batches,B,D] before from_tensor_slices - O(1) slice vs stack-B-samples
Single-input/output model: crash in predict_ensemble_encoded (fixed in next commit)
Single-input/output model: 1 stacked [E*D] input + 1 batched [batch,E,1] output reduces per-step tensor overhead 20→2
Optimise bootstrap gather: transpose [E,N] indices → direct [N,E,D] gather (saves one 60MB alloc/transpose)
Maximise steps_per_execution to n_batches=625: Keras spe is a tf.Variable, so no recompile; 63→1 Python dispatches/epoch
Pre-warm GPU for full-epoch spe: extra warmup advances RNG state and gives slightly worse timing on avg
Explicit steps_per_epoch to skip cardinality inference: higher variance and worse average timing
VEM make_train_function(jit_compile=False): eliminates 625 GPU→CPU syncs/epoch at cost of XLA fusion; GPU util 69→100% but timing ~equal
VEM jit_compile=True (scalar loss + y_pred.mean fix): XLA+sync-free but Epoch1 warm-up 2s; 750ms/epoch x2 still no net gain
